pages.text: Tobacconist is a chain of crafts rather than a single recipe. The normal path is: $(item)seed → mature plant → raw leaf → cured leaf → cut tobacco → optional barrel work → finished product$(). Each stage preserves information from the stage before it.

$(thing)1. Find seeds.$() Wild tobacco grows naturally in Forest, Birch Forest, and Dark Forest. Cultivated varieties come from regional $(thing)Tobacconist$() villagers; different regions stock different pairs of seeds.
pages.title: 1 — Seeds

pages.text: $(thing)2. Grow and harvest.$() Plant seeds on farmland. Tobacco has 8 growth stages (0–7) and becomes two blocks tall after the early stages. Let it fully mature before harvesting if quality matters.
pages.title: 2 — Grow

pages.text: $(thing)3. Cure the leaf.$() Put matching raw leaves on a Tobacco Drying Rack. Air, sun, fire, and flue curing each need different surroundings and take different amounts of time.
pages.title: 3 — Cure

pages.text: $(thing)4. Cut the cured leaf.$() Craft one cured leaf beside a Chaveta. The Chaveta's position determines Ribbon, Shag, Rough, or Flake cut. One leaf produces 3 loose tobacco.
pages.title: 4 — Cut

pages.text: $(thing)5. Refine or craft.$() Loose tobacco can go into a pipe, become a cigarette, become cigar filler, or be cased with Flavoring Essence for aromatics or mixed with flavored molasses into shisha. Cured or loose tobacco can also be fermented or aged in a Tobacco Barrel.
pages.title: 5 — Finish

pages.text: $(thing)6. Inspect as you work.$() Wear Tobacconist's Spectacles. Looking at crops, drying racks, and barrels shows the information you normally need. Sneak-right-clicking crops, racks, and barrels also gives basic status without the Spectacles.
pages.title: 6 — Inspect
